groups.name: Employees
groups.description: Everyone who can be allocated to an engagement

groups.name: Allocation Admins
groups.description: People who maintain reference data for the allocation app

roles.name: Resource Manager
roles.description: Assigns employees to engagements, changes and ends allocations, and checks availability and conflicts across everyone. Sees every employee, engagement and need. Never edits skills, engagements or HR data.

roles.name: Engagement Manager
roles.description: States the staffing needs of the engagements they manage and sees who is allocated to them. Sees no other engagement and cannot allocate anyone.

roles.name: Employee
roles.description: Sees their own profile, assignments and free capacity. Sees nobody else's.

roles.name: Administrator
roles.description: Maintains skills, proficiency levels, employee skills and engagements, and triggers the HR refresh. Does not allocate employees.
